hud.hintPlane: WAIT FOR THE GREEN LIGHT  -  [pause]: PAUSE
hud.hintBalloon: THE BALLOON DRIFTS WITH THE WIND  -  [pause]: PAUSE
hud.tipPlane: The light turns green over the right exit point: jump then.
hud.tipFreefall: Turn toward the gold hoop ([left] [right]) and track ([up]) to fly through it.
hud.tipPull: Pull ([action]) in the altimeter’s amber band — never in the red!
hud.tipCanopy: Fly toward the target. Facing the wind slows you down; [down] brakes.
hud.tipFlare: Your shadow is right below: [action] just above the grass to flare and stand it up.

settings.title: Settings

motionHint.reduced: No shake, speed lines, blinking or wipes.
motionHint.full: Every effect, whatever the system says.

difficultyHint.rookie: Arcade, gentle: light wind, a wide target and big hoops. Score ×1.
difficultyHint.ace: Arcade, the real thing: honest wind, a fair target. Score ×1.5.
difficultyHint.barnstormer: Arcade, rough: strong gusts, a small target, tight hoops, a narrow green light. Score ×2.

settings.controlsHint: Click a key, then press the new one (Esc cancels).
settings.capturing: Press a key for “{{control}}” — Esc cancels.
settings.gamepadHint: Stick or d-pad: fly · A: jump, open, flare · B: back · Start: pause
settings.resetConfirm: Erase every Grand Tour medal and daily-jump best? Arcade boards are kept.

records.title: Hall of Aces
records.emptyHint: Fly a mission to earn your wings.

circuit.title: The Grand Tour
circuit.subtitle: Ten events at five fields, then three period acts. Any medal opens the next event.

fair-first.name: First Jump
fair-first.goal: Jump on the green light, pull in the amber band, stand it up on the target.

fair-hoops.name: Fairground Hoops
fair-hoops.goal: Seven hoops down the free fall — thread them all.

sea-breeze.name: Sea Breeze
sea-breeze.goal: A stiff breeze blows out to sea: aim upwind of the target.

sea-low.name: Low Pull
sea-low.goal: Exit at 1100 m, hard deck at 120 m: pull as low as you dare — never below.

lake-shore.name: Lakeshore
lake-shore.goal: A small target by the water and gusty air: precision first.

field-wagon.name: The Float
field-wagon.goal: The target is moving! Land on the horse-drawn float.

field-crosswind.name: Crosswind
field-crosswind.goal: Strong wind: crab your approach and flare into the wind.

meet-show.name: Exhibition
meet-show.goal: Six hoops and a packed grandstand: put on a show.

meet-grand-prix.name: Grand Prix
meet-grand-prix.goal: Wind, hoops and a moving float: the meet’s final.

fair-balloon.name: The Professor’s Ascension
fair-balloon.goal: No aeroplane: a smoke balloon drifting with the wind. Cut loose at the right moment — no throw — and land on the target.

meet-double.name: The Double Drop
meet-double.goal: Two canopies: open high, cut the first away, fall again, then open the second. The longer the re-fall, the louder the crowd.

sea-grand-act.name: The Grand Act
sea-grand-act.goal: Tiny Broadwick’s act: a double drop from a balloon, over the beach. Mind the sea!

brief.dailyGoal: The same jump for everyone today — beat your best.
brief.arcadeGoal: Three jumps at three fields: the run scores their sum.
brief.keys: [left] [right] turn · [up] track / dive · [down] arch / brakes · [action]: jump, pull, flare

front.exitPlane: Our parachutist left the aeroplane at {{alt}} metres.
front.exitBalloon: Our parachutist cut loose from the balloon at {{alt}} metres.
front.double: A first canopy opens, then breaks away: {{refall}} seconds of re-fall, and the second opens at {{pull}} metres.

landing.standup: Touched down standing, {{dist}} m from the target.
landing.slide: Slid in, {{dist}} m from the target.
landing.tumble: Tumbled in, {{dist}} m from the target.
landing.crash: Hit hard, {{dist}} m from the target.

front.water: Came down… in the water, {{dist}} m from the target, to the crowd’s delight.
front.bullseye: Bang on the bullseye: the crowd swarmed onto the field.
front.crashNoPull: The crowd held its breath: our parachutist never opened. More fright than harm, we are assured backstage.
front.crashLowPull: The crowd held its breath: opened at {{alt}} metres, the canopy had no time to fill. More fright than harm, we are assured backstage.
